# TopologyAwareHarmonyGraph

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A graph-based representation of harmonic relationships where nodes and edges are organized according to topological invariants rather than purely tonal rules. Enables topology-centric computing to encode musical structure as spatial-temporal patterns suitable for neuromorphic mapping.
